summary: Medium-duty 12 V linear actuator in its retracted state. It has a long rectangular extrusion tube along X, a gear housing at the rear, a cylindrical motor mounted alongside the housing, and a cable exiting the housing. A clevis-style hole is visible at the rear mount and at the end of the extension shaft.

mountingSurfaces.description: Shaft-end clevis/tab with a 10 mm cross hole (z-axis). Its position moves with the stroke; shown retracted.
Rear mounting tab on the gear housing end with a 10 mm cross hole (z-axis).

notes: Only the length is stated: 392 mm retracted (assumed hole center to hole center), 642 mm extended, 250 mm actual stroke. The 10 mm mounting hole diameter is stated. Overall width (y = 70) and thickness (z = 40) are rough visual estimates from the product photos, not printed dimensions. The x bound of 402 adds about 5 mm of tab material beyond each hole center, also an estimate. The hole axes are assumed perpendicular to the length and to the stroke-comparison view, and hole positions are assumed centered in y and z. The extended length is 642 mm, so the shaft-end hole would move to x = -446 when fully extended, with the bounds growing to about 652 mm.
